newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank raises amount of bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank raises amount of bond auction.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Thursday it increased the amount of its 28-day bond to be auctioned on Friday by 1.5 billion baht ($60 million) to 3.5 billion baht.
The amount of 91-day bond auction will remain unchanged at 1.0 billion baht, the bank said in a statement.
The bank did not give a reason on Thursday for the increase.
The central bank last week made a similar move and floated an addititional three billion baht of bonds to absorb rising liquidity in the Thai money market.
The bank raised the amount of 28-day bonds scheduled for weekly auction on January 10 to five billion baht from two billion. ($1 = 25 baht)
